selectedIssue.help: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
selectedIssue.description: Ensure the contrast between foreground and background colors meets WCAG 2 AA minimum contrast ratio thresholds

node.html: Order Catering
node.failureSummary:
Fix any of the following:
  Element has insufficient color contrast of 2.42 (foreground color: #ffffff, background color: #ff8604, font size: 13.5pt (18px), font weight: normal). Expected contrast ratio of 4.5:1

remediation.issue: Text must meet minimum contrast requirements.
remediation.explanation: Normal text needs at least 4.5:1 contrast and large text needs at least 3:1 so users with low vision can read the content.

selectedIssue.riskNarrative: Low contrast can make important text difficult to read for customers with low vision, glare sensitivity, aging eyes, or mobile users in bright conditions.
